An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:Are you seeking a new challenge where you can utilize your physical strength and precision? Our client, a renowned company in pallet production, is looking for a Robot Operator for Pallet Production.

As a Robot Operator for Pallet Production, you will be responsible for operating the production robot. Your role includes preparing the workstation: arranging planks and components on the worktable, which are then automatically assembled by the robot. The job requires physical effort, is repetitive in nature, and takes place in a noisy environment. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is up for the challenge.

Your tasks include:

• Preparing and placing planks and components on the worktable.
• Operating and monitoring the production robot.
• Ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.
• Collaborating with the team to ensure smooth production processes.

Profile DescriptionWhat are we looking for?

We are seeking an energetic and physically strong individual who meets the following requirements:

• You are physically fit and comfortable with repetitive tasks.
• You are flexible: until September, you will work in a day shift, and afterward in a two-shift system (morning and afternoon shifts).
• You can communicate in Dutch or English to collaborate effectively with the team.
• You work accurately and have attention to detail.
• You have prior experience in a production environment.

Are you an experienced formwork carpenter? Or maybe you don’t have experience yet but are eager to learn? Is safety and quality your priority? If so, our client is looking for you!

Job Description:

We are looking for Formwork Carpenters to work on various construction projects. The person in this role will be responsible for assembling and dismantling formwork used to shape concrete structural elements.

Responsibilities:

• Preparation, assembly and dismantling of traditional and system formwork (e.g., Peri, Doka).• Carrying out reinforcement and formwork according to technical drawings.• Quality control of completed formwork and ensuring compliance with the project specifications.• Close cooperation with other team members and the site manager.• Ensuring workplace safety and compliance with health and safety regulations.

Requirements:

• Ability to read technical drawings.• Experience as a formwork carpenter or construction worker, welder, or fitter.• Communicative knowledge of English, Dutch, or French.• Ability to work in a team and independently perform assigned tasks.• VCA certificate is an advantage.• Category B driving licence.

Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:

• Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.
• Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.
• Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.
• Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:

• A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.
• CRR holder credentials.
• A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.
• A B licence (river) and A licence (river   coastal) to navigate various waterways.
• Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

Van Heyghen Staal is a modern steel service center located in Evergem, in the Ghent canal zone near the Port of Ghent. Founded in 1981, the company processes around 250,000 tons of steel plates per year on its cut-to-length and slitting lines, and supplies hot-rolled sheets, plates and slit coils to clients across Europe in a wide range of sectors. Its strong position in the European market is built on quality, innovation, service and just-in-time delivery. To support its automated production lines and upcoming projects, Van Heyghen Staal is looking for a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics.

Jobomschrijving

Job descriptionAs a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics, you will start with an extensive learning program in which you will get to know our activities and automated lines in detail. You will build expertise in technology, processes and concepts. After this onboarding period, you can grow within Maintenance, Operations or Projects, depending on your interests and talents.

• Managing spare parts and helping plan preventive and corrective maintenance.
• Analyzing breakdowns and developing sustainable solutions.
• Actively contributing to investment and innovation projects.
• Coaching and supporting the technical team so that production runs continuously and optimally.
• Taking part in a rotation to coordinate Saturday maintenance approximately every 6 weeks.
• Contributing to digitalization and automation projects.
• Supporting energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives.
• Monitoring and improving technical safety procedures.
• Involvement in a production line renewal project.

Profile

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Electromechanics.
• Preferably at least 3 years of experience, but motivated starters are also welcome (junior profile with some experience).
• Broad technical interest: mechanics, pneumatics, electronics, hydraulics and electricity.
• Hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented.
• Knowledge of automation, drive technology and technical drawing is a plus.
• Good command of English is essential; additional languages

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?

• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations.

Who are you?

• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.

Your key responsibilities:

• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:

• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer.

About K-Boringen:With its trenchless installation of pipelines and tunnels, K-Boringen has built a groundbreaking international reputation. Equipped with an extensive fleet of machinery and supported by more than 55 expert employees, K-Boringen guarantees an extremely smooth and flexible service, even in the most challenging work situations. To ensure continued growth, we are currently looking for new colleagues.

Being naturally multilingual and equipped with an impressive machine park, the people at K-Boringen ensure an exceptionally smooth and flexible collaboration, even in the most demanding work conditions.

Using tunnel boring machines, our professionals drill (micro)tunnels with diameters of up to 4 meters over lengths of, for example, 1 km. More information can be found at https://www.k-boringen.com/.

To carry out our drilling projects across Europe, we are looking for motivated, competent employees who have a sense of responsibility and adventure. Our target group consists of workers who are eager to work—especially on-site abroad—who are flexible and skilled in languages.

• Knowledge of hydraulics, welding, and cutting is a plus.
• A solid understanding of electricity is a must.
• Troubleshooting various malfunctions is a challenge for the ideal candidate.
• Preferably, some initial work experience as a laborer and a flexible mindset.
• Willingness to perform physically demanding and dirty work (but done calmly rather than hastily).
• No fear of confined spaces (claustrophobia).
• Fluent in Dutch (additional languages are a plus); if you can communicate well in English, German, or French, you may also qualify.
• Flexibility regarding location and work schedule.
Additional Information:

• You will primarily work within the country, but also regularly in Belgium’s neighboring countries (NL, DE, etc.).
• You will stay on-site from Monday to Friday. During weekends, you return home (you also receive a daily allowance for accommodation).
• You will not work every week of the year; there will be both busy periods (when execution takes place) and quieter periods.
• A driver’s license is not required.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. The company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

Currently in a phase of significant growth, they are looking for motivated and dedicated team members to join their mission.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.

What your day-to-day will look like:

• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
• Supporting transitions between production zones
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.
